test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 25 Jan 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A shopkeeper bought 240 chocolates at ₹9 per dozen. If he sold all of them at ₹1 each, what was his profit percentage?
solution:
**Given:**

240 chocolates were bought at ₹9 per dozen

All of them were sold at ₹1 each

**Concept: **

Profit percentage = (Profit/Cost price) x 100

**Solution:**

Cost price of each chocolate = ₹9/12 = ₹0.75&
